# Off-GPU inventory

**GPU 100% target: every site below ticked off, nothing off the GPU.**

Generated by `node scripts/off-gpu-scan.mjs --doc` (`npm run offgpu`); do not edit by hand. The checklist at the end is regenerated from the scan, so a site leaves it when it moves to the GPU.
No percentage blocks a push or a deploy; the honest score is printed and the target is 100%. What each category means is at the top of the script.

**835/5168 on GPU (16% honest, counting 778 class-write and timer/observer sites; target 100%), 4333 off: frame path 2476, during use 1848, no caller found 9; 405 setup sites left out of the count and listed; 1537 tagged run-once/rare allocations (// alloc-rare: reason) also left out, listed with their reasons; per-frame view (event-only sites set aside): 835/3320 on GPU (25%), 1848 event-only sites listed apart (timer or rest pass 556, stored callback 328, promise 313, event handler 296, observer 170, store or registry listener 146, event or timer 23, motion handler 7, a method of this name is called from promise 5, a method of this name is called from timer or rest pass 3, a method of this name is called from event handler 1)**.

**Warm garbage: 129378 B/frame over 10 frame functions** (compiled, in node; `npm run warm`), all within their limits. stage frame with the vessels (stage.js + veins-gl.js, 60 Hz display, 30 Hz model) 71760 B; pressure-time chart drawn by the GPU pen (pressure-time.js + trace-gl.js, update and redraw) 15418 B; display-state: colour follows, scalar follows and the shown state, a frame of each 1022 B; label-gl: reading 30 labels (describeBlock, svgOnly, lookKey), as a sync reads those that changed 35719 B; glass-gl: the blur plan of eight glasses (blurBoxesInto), a picture 2 B; blood.advanceStream, 40 streams 2290 B; pressure-time ingest (real engine frames) 3161 B; flow-rows changedRows + retireRows + flowClose 2 B; uniform-cache, a frame of fifty uniforms 2 B; veins-bin splitCells into a kept record 2 B.
